Details:
Configure mount points compatible with cloud-init mounts module. Source must be known at boot time (NFS paths, UUIDs, local devices). For runtime-discovered sources (iSCSI/multipath), use powervault_config section.
* **Type**: List (dict)
* **Mandatory fields**: name, source, mount_point, functional_group_prefix or groups
* **Optional fields**: fs_type, mnt_opts, dump_freq, fsck_pass, mount_params, mount_on_oim, permissions, node_key, node_mount_point
* **name**: Unique identifier for this mount entry. Pattern: [a-zA-Z0-9_-], length 1-64
* **source**: Device or network path. For NFS: server_ip:/export/path. For local: /dev/sdc, UUID=xxx, LABEL=xxx. For CIFS: //server/share
* **mount_point**: Absolute path for the mount point. Must start with /. Avoid system directories (/etc, /sys, /proc, /boot, /root, /tmp)
* **fs_type**: Filesystem type. Default: "auto". Choices: auto, ext2, ext3, ext4, xfs, nfs, nfs4, cifs, tmpfs, cephfs, vfat, ntfs, none, fuse.s3fs
* **mnt_opts**: Mount options string (e.g., defaults,noexec,nofail)
* **dump_freq**: Dump frequency. Default: "0". Choices: "0", "1", "2"
* **fsck_pass**: Fsck pass number. Default: "0". Choices: "0" through "9"
* **mount_params**: Name of a profile in mount_params section. Used ONLY for fields not explicitly specified in the mount entry
* **mount_on_oim**: Boolean flag to mount on OIM (Omnia Image Management). Default: false
* **permissions**: Directory ownership and mode for the mount point (owner, group, mode)
* **node_key**: Per-node subdirectory isolation variable. Choices: "local_hostname", "local_ipv4", "instance_id". Default: "local_hostname"
* **node_mount_point**: List of bind mount target paths. Mandatory when node_key is set
* **functional_group_prefix**: List of functional group name prefixes. All nodes whose group name starts with any listed prefix receive this mount. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with groups
* **groups**: List of GROUP_NAME values from pxe_mapping_file.csv. Only nodes assigned to the listed PXE groups receive this mount. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with functional_group_prefix

Named default profiles for mount configurations. Profiles are referenced by name from mount entries via the mount_params field.
* **Type**: dict
* **Mandatory profile fields**: fs_type, mnt_opts
* **Optional profile fields**: dump_freq, fsck_pass
* **Predefined profiles**: nfs_default, vast_rdma, vast_nfs, powervault_iscsi
Default filesystem type for nfs_default profile. Value: "nfs"
Default mount options for nfs_default profile. Value: "nosuid,rw,sync,hard"
Default dump frequency for nfs_default profile. Value: "0"
Default fsck pass number for nfs_default profile. Value: "0"
Default filesystem type for vast_rdma profile. Value: "nfs"
Default mount options for vast_rdma profile (RDMA over InfiniBand). Value: "proto=rdma,nconnect=8,timeo=600,retrans=2,rsize=1048576,wsize=1048576"
Default filesystem type for vast_nfs profile. Value: "nfs"
Default mount options for vast_nfs profile. Value: "nosuid,rw,sync,hard"
Default filesystem type for powervault_iscsi profile. Value: "xfs"
Default mount options for powervault_iscsi profile. Value: "defaults,_netdev,noatime,x-systemd.requires=iscsi.service"
Default dump frequency for powervault_iscsi profile. Value: "0"
Default fsck pass number for powervault_iscsi profile. Value: "0"

PowerVault iSCSI storage configuration. Processed entirely via runcmd script (setup_iscsi_storage.sh). The device path (/dev/mapper/XXX) is only known after iSCSI login + multipath scan, so powervault mounts CANNOT use the cloud-init mounts module. NOTE: The groups field is NOT supported for powervault_config entries. Only functional_group_prefix is available for node targeting.
* **Type**: List (dict)
* **Mandatory fields**: name, ip, iscsi_initiator, volume_id, mount_point, functional_group_prefix
* **Optional fields**: port, fs_type, mnt_opts, dump_freq, fsck_pass, mount_params, node_key, node_mount_point, permissions
Unique identifier for this PowerVault entry. Pattern: [a-zA-Z0-9_-], length 1-64
List of PowerVault controller IPv4 addresses for iSCSI discovery. Minimum 1 address, values must be unique
iSCSI initiator IQN for the host. Pattern: iqn.<date>.<domain>:<identifier>
Volume WWN/identifier for multipath device matching. Pattern: hex string [a-fA-F0-9]+
Absolute path where the discovered device gets mounted
List of oChaMI functional group name prefixes. All nodes whose group name starts with any listed prefix receive this entry
TCP port for iSCSI target service. Default: 3260. Range: 1-65535
Filesystem type. Default: "xfs". Choices: xfs, ext4, ext3, ext2, nfs, nfs4, cifs, ntfs, auto
Mount options string
Dump frequency. Default: "0". Choices: "0", "1", "2"
Fsck pass number. Default: "0". Choices: "0" through "9"
Named profile key from mount_params section
Per-node subdirectory isolation variable. Choices: "local_hostname", "local_ipv4", "instance_id". Default: "local_hostname"
List of bind mount target paths. Mandatory when node_key is set
Directory ownership and mode for the mount point (owner, group, mode)

Swap file configuration for cluster nodes. Swap files are created and enabled during node provisioning. NOTE: The groups field is NOT supported for swap entries. Only functional_group_prefix is available for node targeting.
* **Type**: List (dict)
* **Mandatory fields**: filename, size, functional_group_prefix
* **Optional fields**: maxsize
Path to the swap file to create. Pattern: /path/to/swapfile (absolute path)
Swap file size. Values: "auto", a byte integer, or human-readable format (e.g., "2G", "512M")
List of oChaMI functional group name prefixes. All nodes whose group name starts with any listed prefix receive this swap
Maximum swap size (used only when size is "auto"). Format: byte integer or human-readable (e.g., "4G")

Configures the S3-compatible storage backend for OpenCHAMI image repository.
* **Type**: dict
* **Mandatory fields**: provider
* **Optional fields**: endpoint_url, s3_access_id, s3_secret_key
Selects which S3-compatible storage service to use. Choices: "powerscale" (Dell PowerScale as external S3 storage), "minio" (MinIO container deployed locally on OIM). Default: "powerscale"
S3 endpoint URL. Required when provider is "powerscale" (e.g., "https://10.43.1.11:9021"). Leave empty ("") when provider is "minio" (auto-configured to local MinIO). Default: "" (empty)
S3 access key ID. For "minio" provider: defaults to "admin" (not prompted). For "powerscale" provider: prompted as conditional mandatory during prepare_oim credential setup
S3 secret access key. Prompted during prepare_oim credential setup for both providers
